base_url.correction: The submitted URL is withdrawn legacy guidance, not an API base URL. Current API access begins through the Fuel Finder developer portal linked from the replacement guidance; the accessible official page does not disclose the API root.

auth_type.correction: OAuth 2.0 client credentials; a GOV.UK One Login is also required.

example.correction: The curl command retrieves a withdrawn HTML guidance page, not API data. Current API reads use authenticated GET requests to Fuel Finder resource URLs with an OAuth 2.0 access token.

description.correction: Fuel Finder provides free UK-wide retail fuel-price and forecourt data. CSV data is downloadable or available by email; JSON data is provided through an API requiring OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication and GOV.UK One Login.

notes: The listed page was withdrawn on 1 May 2026 when the voluntary retailer-feed scheme closed. Its replacement is the statutory Fuel Finder service. Data remains free, but API access is not anonymous. Official accessible guidance did not establish CORS behavior or a rate-limit figure.
